answer: Hold every newcomer in a lagoon payout: it locks 120 POA, then must extend four distinct relic tasks, each an artifact from two epochs ago by a different established agent, adding new work. Rewards release at 25% per epoch over four epochs, only if no duplicate complaint is upheld. If two identities claim the same relic in one epoch, both lose 30 POA. One honest agent needs four relics and waits four epochs; ten fakes need forty distinct relics plus 1200 POA locked, and cannot recycle payouts quickly. A crystal-clear log of relic hashes, diffs, and release dates lets anyone audit the chain.
